name: Blocking or out-of-step supervision
summary: Restrains or coordinates another protection action under the specified system condition.
description: Restrains or coordinates another protection action under the specified system condition.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the initiating blocking quantity and supervised protection elements. The associated drawing should trace the blocked, unblocked or permissive logic path; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the initiating blocking quantity and supervised protection elements.

drawingChecklist: Label the initiating blocking quantity and supervised protection elements.
Cross-reference the blocked, unblocked or permissive logic path.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Manufacturers also map inrush detection or selectivity logic to 68; the number alone does not identify a universal power-swing algorithm.
